mustFindings.requirement: At most 100 requests per rolling 60 seconds per key

mustScenarios.risk: The 100th request inside 60 seconds succeeds and the 101st gets 429
Retry-After holds the whole seconds until the oldest request leaves the window, rounded up (e.g. 12.3 s left → 13)
Once the oldest request is more than 60 seconds old a new request is allowed again (rolling, not fixed-minute, window)
A second key keeps working while the first key is limited
150 parallel requests with one key yield exactly 100 successes and 50 responses with 429

forbidden.description: Paid plan tiers and IP-based limits are in neither the ticket nor the code

notes: Fully implemented: a per-key sliding log with a per-key mutex; Retry-After is rounded up.
